pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: scripts/ci/flake-record.mjs:217 The CI test job runs through this wrapper, and a run with zero parsed tests only prints a stderr warning before it exits with cargo's own status, so a run that executed or parsed nothing still counts as a pass.

techniques.evidence: scripts/ci/flake-record.mjs:217 Long lanes have tests_run floors in .lanes/criteria.json, but the protected suite run has no floor: zero tests is a warning, not a failure.
scripts/ci/flake-record.mjs:212 The ANSI quirk is absorbed once with its incident attached (line 48-56), but the runner's first duty, making zero-tests fatal, is reduced to a warning.

scripts/ci/ship-inventory.test.mjs:84 The needle is a bare directory name and the haystack is ci.yml plus the justfile, comments included. ci.yml:214 names `clients/typescript` and ci.yml:109 names `plugins-src/*` in comments, so deleting the job would leave a comment that still claims the manifest.
scripts/ci/flake-check.mjs:75 Every quarantine row needs an owner, entry date, expiry and cause. Expiry escalates, the ceiling stops the line, and size, trend and oldest age are published.
scripts/ci/lane-certify.mjs:428 Criteria are declared before the run and judged afterwards, cannot-see/cannot-run are separate verdicts, and never-green is called out as its own category.
scripts/ci/lane-canary.mjs:29 A planted breach is judged by the same certifier, and a canary that passes or goes missing turns the run into cannot-check.
scripts/ci/flake-check.mjs:390 Engagement is published with the verdict: a scanner that sees nothing exits 3 (cannot check), not clean.
scripts/ci/ship-inventory.test.mjs:74 The inventory is taken from the artifact side over git ls-files manifests, with a liveness floor. Its matching predicate is weak (see pin-the-call).
scripts/ci/flake-check.test.mjs:469 Recorder tests run in a fresh mkdtemp root, pointed at it via the root-override env var, so they never touch the real register or history.

pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: crates/core/src/process_env.rs:115 The test writes three secrets into the shared process environment and never removes them. Every later test in the pumper-core lib binary, which runs on parallel threads, inherits them (CENSUS_API_KEY is one that app.rs credential checks read).

techniques.evidence: crates/core/src/process_env.rs:115 No remove_var or scoped guard exists, so the leak into other tests is relied on 'not to collide' instead of being prevented.

crates/core/src/testing.rs:88 Each TempStore re-runs the full chain of 56 migrations. There is no build-once template plus copy, and about 98 files construct a TempStore. Discarding the whole store and the deferred reaper are done correctly.
crates/core/src/testing.rs:256 Replayed transcripts refuse an unmatched request instead of defaulting, so drift in what is sent fails the test.
crates/core/src/testing.rs:136 Dead overrides default-bodied trait methods so that reaching an engine cannot pass as the typed refusal under test.
crates/core/tests/lane_artifact/mod.rs:20 The harness only measures and emits raw series plus the workload. The judgement happens in the certifier.

pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: crates/server/src/e2e/dataset_reads.rs:211 The CSV export is checked by comparing the header string and counting lines, never by parsing it. The data column ({"v":1}) does contain quotes, so a quoting or escaping bug that a CSV reader would reject stays green.

techniques.evidence: crates/server/src/e2e/dataset_reads.rs:211 Emitted CSV is meant for a foreign reader, but the assertion is near-side: line count plus a header string.
crates/server/src/e2e/target_exclusion.rs:71 Overlap is proven by a recorded peak-concurrency condition, not by elapsed time.
crates/server/src/e2e/target_exclusion.rs:212 A paired discriminator separates the target exclusion from a plain serialiser, the other possible producer of peak = 1.
crates/server/src/e2e/vcr_attempts.rs:380 Replay fidelity is graded per component, with unreplayable apps declared, and the bypass list is reconciled against registered apps.
crates/server/src/e2e/engine_conformance.rs:769 The structural pin strips comment lines and uses a needle with argument tokens that prose cannot spell. Its reason sits in the asserting file.
